card.name: The word over after infusion
card.fires_on: The word "over" right after "infusion" or "administered subcutaneously", where a duration comes next, such as 30 minutes or one hour.

modes.label: Infusion duration
modes.description: "over" follows intravenous infusion and introduces how long the infusion runs.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of BAVENCIO is 800 mg administered as an intravenous infusion<< over>> 60 minutes every 2 weeks
